title: Musk’s Merger Math: More Control, No Trillion-Dollar Windfall
gist: Citing Reuters and Barclays, the post argues a SpaceX acquisition of Tesla would mainly hand Elon Musk majority voting control (about 37% ownership but 56% of votes) rather than automatically unlocking Tesla's trillion-dollar pay package, which would still require Tesla to reach at least $2 trillion. It frames the deal as needing separate industrial-rationale and governance assessments.
